Ruffer Llp Increased Kinross Gold Corp (NYSE:KGC) Stake by $34.87 Million
May 23, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Ruffer Llp increased its stake in Kinross Gold Corp (NYSE:KGC) by 49% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ruffer Llp bought 11.62 million shares as the company’s stock declined 6.82% with the market. The institutional investor held 35.35M shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $139.92 million, up from 23.72 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ruffer Llp who had been investing in Kinross Gold Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $4.51 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.83% or $0.03 during the last trading session, reaching $3.59. About 6.39 million shares traded. Kinross Gold Corporation (NYSE:KGC) has risen 13.79% uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.24% the S&P500.
Ruffer Llp, which manages about $2.04 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Canadian Solar Inc (NASDAQ:CSIQ) by 1.18 million shares to 119,405 shares, valued at $1.94M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 490,458 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 276,261 shares, and cut its stake in Bancorp Del (NYSE:USB). Kinross Gold has $5.5 highest and $3.5000 lowest target. $4.40’s average target is 22.56% above currents $3.59 stock price. Kinross Gold had 5 analyst reports since December 3, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. RBC Capital Markets maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Tuesday, April 3 report. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Sunday, December 3 by RBC Capital Markets. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Wednesday, April 11 by Deutsche Bank. BMO Capital Markets maintained it with “Buy” rating and $4.75 target in Monday, December 18 report. The stock has “Hold” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Monday, April 9.
